senses.gloss:
mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Carried or placed upon the hip or flank.
E.
उत्सङ्ग, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Omitting, leaving.
2 Terminative, completing^1, relating or belonging to a final ceremony, by which the rite is dismissed.
3 Natural, inherent.
4 Derivative, produced from or of, directly and naturally.
E.
उत्सर्ग abandoned, and ठञ् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-क्यं)
Anxiety, perturbation, regret.
E.
उत्सुक anxious, ष्यञ् aff.
